doc.english: Provides generated DescribeVpcs and a page-number paginator for Vpc API 2016-04-28. Coverage includes selected fields only. Use New with shared Config; clients are concurrency safe and inputs are copied. Errors preserve structured service causes and context cancellation.
doc.chinese: 提供 Vpc 2016-04-28 的生成 DescribeVpcs 和页码 paginator，仅覆盖选定字段。使用共享 Config 构造 New；客户端并发安全，复制输入；错误保留结构化服务原因及 context 取消。

doc.english: Selects a nonempty tag key of up to 128 Unicode characters; reserved prefixes and URL substrings are rejected.
doc.chinese: 选择非空标签键，最多 128 个 Unicode 字符；拒绝保留前缀和 URL 子串。

doc.english: Selects an optional tag value of up to 128 Unicode characters; nil omits it and new("") explicitly sends an empty value.
doc.chinese: 选择可选标签值，最多 128 个 Unicode 字符；nil 省略，new("") 显式发送空值。

doc.english: Selects one reviewed tag filter; pointer members are copied before use.
doc.chinese: 选择一个审核标签过滤，使用前复制指针成员。

doc.english: Contains selected wire field Key.
doc.chinese: 包含选定线字段 Key。

doc.english: Contains selected wire field Value.
doc.chinese: 包含选定线字段 Value。

doc.english: Contains a returned VPC tag.
doc.chinese: 包含返回的 VPC 标签。

doc.english: Contains selected wire field Ipv6Isp.
doc.chinese: 包含选定线字段 Ipv6Isp。

doc.english: Contains selected wire field Ipv6CidrBlock.
doc.chinese: 包含选定线字段 Ipv6CidrBlock。

doc.english: Contains a selected IPv6 block and its ISP.
doc.chinese: 包含选定 IPv6 网段及 ISP。

doc.english: Contains selected wire field VpcId.
doc.chinese: 包含选定线字段 VpcId。

doc.english: Contains selected wire field VpcName.
doc.chinese: 包含选定线字段 VpcName。

doc.english: Contains selected wire field RegionId.
doc.chinese: 包含选定线字段 RegionId。

doc.english: Contains the service lifecycle state; unknown future values are retained.
doc.chinese: 包含服务生命周期状态，保留未来未知值。

doc.english: Contains selected wire field CidrBlock.
doc.chinese: 包含选定线字段 CidrBlock。

doc.english: Contains selected wire field Ipv6CidrBlock.
doc.chinese: 包含选定线字段 Ipv6CidrBlock。

doc.english: Contains selected wire field IsDefault.
doc.chinese: 包含选定线字段 IsDefault。

doc.english: Contains selected wire field EnabledIpv6.
doc.chinese: 包含选定线字段 EnabledIpv6。

doc.english: Contains the owner account ID without floating-point conversion.
doc.chinese: 包含 owner 账号 ID，不经过浮点转换。

doc.english: Contains selected wire field Tags.Tag.
doc.chinese: 包含选定线字段 Tags.Tag。

doc.english: Contains selected wire field Ipv6CidrBlocks.Ipv6CidrBlock.
doc.chinese: 包含选定线字段 Ipv6CidrBlocks.Ipv6CidrBlock。

doc.english: Contains the service-returned vSwitch ID subset; use the dedicated API for a complete list.
doc.chinese: 包含服务返回的 vSwitch ID 子集，完整列表需专用 API。

doc.english: Contains selected VPC properties with flattened nested containers; unknown response fields are ignored.
doc.chinese: 包含选定 VPC 属性并展平嵌套容器，忽略未知响应字段。

doc.english: Defaults to the client region; the per-call region override takes precedence.
doc.chinese: 默认使用客户端地域，调用级地域覆盖优先。

doc.english: Selects a VPC ID or up to twenty comma-separated IDs; empty omits the filter.
doc.chinese: 选择 VPC ID 或最多二十个逗号分隔 ID，空值省略过滤。

doc.english: Selects a VPC name; empty omits the filter.
doc.chinese: 选择 VPC 名称，空值省略过滤。

doc.english: Selects a resource group; empty omits the filter.
doc.chinese: 选择资源组，空值省略过滤。

doc.english: Selects a DHCP options set; empty omits the filter.
doc.chinese: 选择 DHCP 选项集，空值省略过滤。

doc.english: Selects the default-VPC filter; nil delegates omission/default behavior to the service.
doc.chinese: 选择默认 VPC 过滤，nil 的省略/默认行为由服务决定。

doc.english: Requests a preflight when true; DryRunOperation remains a structured service error.
doc.chinese: true 请求预检，DryRunOperation 保留为结构化服务错误。

doc.english: Filters IPv6 enablement; nil means no filter, false selects disabled and true selects enabled.
doc.chinese: 过滤 IPv6 启用状态，nil 不过滤，false 选择未启用，true 选择已启用。

doc.english: Selects an owner account; zero omits the filter and negative values are rejected.
doc.chinese: 选择 owner 账号，零值省略过滤，拒绝负值。

doc.english: Selects a one-based page; zero omits it (service default one).
doc.chinese: 选择从一开始的页码，零值省略（服务默认一）。

doc.english: Selects up to fifty results per page; zero omits it (service default ten).
doc.chinese: 选择每页最多五十条，零值省略（服务默认十条）。

doc.english: Selects up to twenty tag filters encoded as Tag.N.Key/Value; all pointer and slice members are copied.
doc.chinese: 选择最多二十个 tag 过滤，编码为 Tag.N.Key/Value，复制所有指针及切片成员。

doc.english: Contains selected wire field Vpcs.Vpc.
doc.chinese: 包含选定线字段 Vpcs.Vpc。

doc.english: Contains selected wire field PageNumber.
doc.chinese: 包含选定线字段 PageNumber。

doc.english: Contains selected wire field PageSize.
doc.chinese: 包含选定线字段 PageSize。

doc.english: Contains the matching count used by page-number traversal.
doc.chinese: 包含纯页码分页使用的匹配总数。

doc.english: Queries one selected VPC page; nil input uses the client region and service defaults. Callers must not mutate input concurrently.
doc.chinese: 查询一页选定 VPC，nil 输入使用客户端地域及服务默认值，调用者不得并发修改输入。
